en: Sepia-toned postcard showing a photograph of an ancient Roman-style mosaic. The composition centers on a circular medallion with the bust of a figure wearing draped clothing and a laurel-like headpiece, surrounded by intricate geometric and braided patterns. Smaller panels in the corners contain animal or fish motifs. At the bottom margin of the image is a printed caption in French identifying the subject as a mosaic from Timgad.
